summary: Frontend-only testing of new BPJS Ketenagakerjaan tab (JHT & JP). All 11 test scenarios PASSED. Tab navigation shows 4 tabs, BpjsCalculator renders empty state, real-time auto-calculation works via useMemo, sliders/inputs recalculate live, JP eligibility toggles correctly between MPB Berkala and Lump Sum, JP wage cap warning triggers at >Rp 10.547.400, and regression on Pesangon/Riwayat/Panduan tabs passes. Mobile 375px viewport renders correctly.

issues: Recharts emits console warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' before container mounts — cosmetic only, chart renders correctly after data present

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer initial mount warning — consider adding minWidth={0} or an explicit height fallback in the parent to suppress console noise.
MiniStat values for JHT iuran bulanan (Rp 570.000 total, Rp 200.000 pekerja) don't have data-testid — would help future regression assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter5 verified: JHT saldo (gaji 10jt, 27→56, 8% raise, 5.5% yield) = Rp 1.290.782.279 with +Rp 579.655.275 pengembangan. JP MPB @58 = Rp 3.264.220/bln. JP Lump Sum @40 = Rp 70.935.255. Slider changes (12% raise + 7% yield) → saldo Rp 2.778.585.637. Saldo awal 50jt added → Rp 3.134.298.490. 20jt gaji triggers JP cap warning. All existing tabs (Pesangon, Riwayat, Panduan) render without regression. Mobile viewport OK.
